currency_accounts_owner_check.name: currency_accounts_owner_check
currency_accounts_owner_check.value: ("currency_accounts"."kind" = 'family_treasury' and "currency_accounts"."family_id" is not null and "currency_accounts"."code" is null) or ("currency_accounts"."kind" = 'system' and "currency_accounts"."code" is not null and "currency_accounts"."family_id" is null)

henchmen_active_fields_check.name: henchmen_active_fields_check
henchmen_active_fields_check.value: ("henchmen"."status" = 'active') = ("henchmen"."wage_paid_until" is not null) and ("henchmen"."status" = 'active' or "henchmen"."assigned_territory_id" is null)

territories_owner_fields_check.name: territories_owner_fields_check
territories_owner_fields_check.value: ("territories"."owner_family_id" is null) = ("territories"."upkeep_paid_until" is null) and ("territories"."owner_family_id" is null) = ("territories"."owned_since" is null)

trade_lines_item_check.name: trade_lines_item_check
trade_lines_item_check.value: ("trade_lines"."good" is not null and "trade_lines"."quantity" > 0 and "trade_lines"."cash" is null) or ("trade_lines"."good" is null and "trade_lines"."quantity" is null and "trade_lines"."cash" > 0)
